snippet.title: Dragon's Lair III: The Curse of Mordread [Full playthrough + All Death Animations]
snippet.description:
I never knew this game existed until not too long ago. There's no death scene compilation yet on YouTube, so I thought I would make my own.

Turn on captions if you are curious about the necessary inputs.

Sorry about the quality, but YouTube hates low resolution videos (original video is 640x400 resolution). If you want a better quality video, this is also available on archive.org.

Dragon's Lair III: The Curse of Mordread was released in 1992 for MS-DOS, Amiga and Atari ST. It was a follow-up to, and contains re-used scenes from Dragon's Lair II: Time Warp (albeit truncated) but also contains new and original scenes, including the pirate scene that was originally planned for Dragon's Lair II.

Timestamps (titles adapted from manual):
0:00 Title and Credits
0:11 The Witch Appears
0:32 Doorway to Wonderland
1:17 Beethoven's Fifth
1:41 Skull and Cross Bones
2:01 The Land of Time
2:43 Home At Last
2:52 Death: Zapped
2:54 Death: Chomped by bat
2:56 Death: Gravity
2:58 Death: Queen of Hearts
3:00 Death: Mad Hatter
3:01 Death: Smoke
3:03 Death: Joker
3:05 Death: Zapped 2
3:06 Death: Chomped by cat
3:07 Death: Candle wax
3:09 Death: Shot in the head
3:11 Death: Head chopped off
3:12 Death: Eaten by shark
3:15 Death: Bonked by clock
3:17 Death: Coiled by clockwork
3:18 Death: Rapid ageing

Some of these won't shop up correctly on the timeline because the deaths are too close together to be made into chapters.
